title: Identification of cuproptosis-related biomarkers in dilated cardiomyopathy and potential therapeutic prediction of herbal medicines.
summary: LASSO, random forest and SVM-RFE selection converged on FDX1 and SLC31A1 as DCM signature genes; XGBoost assessment gave AUC/PR 0.924/0.919 in GSE141910 and 0.846/0.768 in GSE57338, with expression/ROC checks in external GSE19303 and GSE21610. The result is computational biomarker evidence, not proof of causality or herbal treatment efficacy.
